name: @reticlehq/server
description: Reticle CLI, bridge and MCP server: a coding agent drives your running web app from the inside and gets a verdict with evidence, for change verification, access control, accessibility, performance and SEO checks.

scripts.prepack: node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs --clean dist && tsc -b --force && node ../scripts/alias-dist.mjs && node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs dist && node ../scripts/stamp-issuer-key.mjs && node ../scripts/pack-docs.mjs

author: Reticle contributors

reticle.changelog: 3.10.0 checks every change against what worked before. reticle compare and verify --against list what users would see change between two builds, and reticle grade grades a finished run from the app's stored data. Several false verdicts are fixed, most of them text checks that answered no for text that was on the page. An agent in a Claude Code worktree now reaches its own tab. Update the CLI and the SDK in your app.
breakingChanges: The commands kill, login, link, project, whoami, push, regression, share, issues and memory are removed. Each prints the command that replaces it and exits 1. See MIGRATION.md.
The MCP tools reticle_explore and reticle_replay left the tool surface. Use reticle_look { action: "page", mode: "interactive" } and reticle_record { action: "replay" }.
